entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your order, can I please have your name and email address?
Michael Chen, m.chen@email.com. Just need the return label, please.

Thank you, Mr. Chen. I have your order right here. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th. To proceed, I just need to ask a quick question. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. The device is just **hard to use**. Frankly, I **expected more** from the interface. It's not intuitive at all.
I see. I'm sorry to hear it wasn't a good fit for you. Did you have a chance to look at the setup guide in the **user manual**?
Yes, I read the manual. It's still **confusing**. Look, can I return it or not? I don't have time for a long call.
Of course. I understand completely. Let me just check the return eligibility based on your delivery date. One moment.
Alright, Mr. Chen, I've checked the policy. Since your VeloBand was delivered 35 days ago, it is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can approve this return for you right now.
Okay, good. So you'll email me a shipping label?

That's correct. I've just processed the authorization. You should receive an email with the prepaid return label and instructions within the next 5 to 10 minutes. Just pack the item in its original box and drop it off.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
